crossBold: {leader} will not hear of the long way round: they go straight {through} {name}.
crossHurry: With people waiting on them, they take the quick way {through} {name}.
There is no time to go around; they cut {through} {name}.
cross: They talk it over at the edge of {name} and decide to chance the way {through}.
The way round {name} would cost them {days}; they go {through}.
skirt: They give {name} a wide berth and take the long way round, a detour of {days}.
{leader} wants no part of {name}; they go around it, {days} out of their way.
skirtWounded: Hurt as they are, nobody wants to risk {name} again; they limp the long way round ({days} more).
They carry their wounded around {name} rather than through it, {days} the longer.
skirtOverruled: {bold} wants to cut {through} {name}, but the others outvote them and they take the long way round ({days} more).
shortRest: They stop for an hour to catch their breath and bind their wounds.
A short rest in a quiet corner: water, bandages, a whetstone.
shortRestInterrupted: Their rest is cut short: something has heard them.
camp: They make camp for the night and post a watch.
A cold camp under the stars, a watch kept in turns.
campAmbush: Deep in the night, {watcher} on watch hears movement beyond the firelight.
Something comes for their camp in the dark; {watcher} raises the alarm.
campSurprised: Something comes for their camp in the dark, and {watcher}, on watch, has nodded off.
campBefore: They reach {site} late in the day and camp out of sight to go in at first light, rested.
fallBack: They fall back out of {site}, find a hollow a safe distance off and sleep the long sleep of the exhausted.
They pull back to a ruined wall a mile off, light no fire, and rest until they can fight again.
tryAgain: Rested and healed, they go back in to finish what they started. {site} is ready for them this time.
At first light they try again. The defenders have had time to prepare too.
giveUp: Twice beaten, they know when the place is beyond them.

ranges._doc: Mountain walls between the far rings, broken only at passes: at sites in their line and a few more (Roads.Ranges). Days but arc in degrees.

kinds.name: ridge

text: a rockslide on the high pass
a blizzard rolls over the saddle
a ledge gives way under their boots

ambushText: something with wings and claws drops on them from the crags
a band of raiders lying in wait at the top of the pass

kinds.name: mire

text: sucking mud to the waist
a fever off the stagnant water
leeches the size of a hand

ambushText: the water stirs and something rises out of it
eyes in the reeds, then teeth

kinds.name: deep wood

text: they lose the path among the briars
a deadfall rigged across a game trail
a stinging cloud of spores from a rotten log

ambushText: shapes move between the trees, keeping pace with them
a hunting pack picks up their scent

kinds.name: gorge

text: a rope bridge sways and a plank snaps
they climb down one wall and up the other
the ford at the bottom runs white and fast

ambushText: something lairs under the bridge
rocks come down from above, thrown by someone

kinds.name: haunted ground

text: a chill that settles in the bones and will not leave
voices on the wind that call them by name
a grave mist that steals the breath

ambushText: the dead do not lie quiet here
a barrow door stands open, and something walks out of it

kinds.name: badlands

text: the heat and no water
a dust storm that strips the skin
the ground cracks and vents scalding steam

ambushText: something burrows up out of the sand
riders on the horizon, coming fast

kinds.name: icefield

text: a crevasse hidden under fresh snow
cold that bites through every layer
a whiteout that turns them in circles

ambushText: white shapes rise out of the snow
a hunter of the ice has been following them

kinds.name: lake

text: a squall sweeps the open water
the cold off the water in their bones

ambushText: something long and pale rises under them
the water's own guardian does not like trespassers

kinds.name: peaks

text: winds off the summits that throw them about
thin air and a long way to fall

ambushText: something nests on the summits and comes down for them
rocs wheel above the peaks

kinds.name: mountain wall

text: a storm on the high wall that throws them against the rock
a cornice gives way under the leader

ambushText: something that nests on the wall drops on them
giants on the heights roll stones down the pass

kinds.name: hunting grounds

text: fresh tracks bigger than a cart wheel
a kill left out as bait

ambushText: the pack has been pacing them for a mile
something big comes out of the long grass
they walk straight into the beasts' feeding ground

kinds.name: monster haunts

text: the bones of the last party to try it
nests in every hollow

ambushText: the hollow they camp in is somebody's lair
a monster's brood boils out of the ground
the ground itself opens its mouth
